p: Manali is a popular hill station located in the Kullu Valley of Himachal Pradesh, India.
Nestled in the Himalayas, it is known for its snow-capped peaks, lush green valleys, and pleasant climate.
It's a favorite destination for honeymooners, adventure seekers, and nature lovers.
Activities like skiing, paragliding, rafting, and trekking attract tourists all year round.
Haridwar is one of the seven holiest places in Hinduism, located in the state of Uttarakhand, India.
Situated on the banks of the sacred Ganges River, it is known for its spiritual significance and vibrant Ganga Aarti.
The city attracts millions of pilgrims and tourists who come to take a dip in the holy river and seek blessings.
Haridwar is a major destination during the Kumbh Mela, one of the largest religious gatherings in the world.
Rishikesh, known as the 'Yoga Capital of the World', is located close to Haridwar in Uttarakhand.
It's a serene town famous for yoga retreats, spiritual ashrams, and the scenic beauty of the Ganges River.
It also offers thrilling adventure activities like white-water rafting and bungee jumping.
Mussoorie is a beautiful hill station in Uttarakhand, often called the 'Queen of the Hills'.
It is known for its colonial charm, panoramic views of the Doon Valley, and pleasant climate.
It attracts both leisure travelers and honeymooners alike.
